text:
Hamburg’s median asking rent sits at 15.47 €/m² in June 2026, up 5.1 % year‑on‑year and 28.5 % over the past five years, placing the city fifth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The asking premium over existing rents is 69 %, with a typical 60 m² apartment costing about 928 € per month.

The market remains tight: vacancy is just 1 %, listings spend an average of 23 days on market and 37 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 18.8 %, while mortgage rates sit at 4.01 %.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 16.28 €/m² twelve months ahead, ranging between 15.91 €/m² and 16.67 €/m², implying a further 5.2 % increase.
